attributes.description: The Enterprise STIG Compliance Dashboard provides a centralized view of enterprise security compliance based on assessment results from NIWC Atlantic's SCAP Compliance Checker (SCC). It presents overall compliance posture, monitored systems, high-risk assets, findings by severity and operating system, and compliance trends over time. Interactive filters enable targeted analysis by operating system, STIG benchmark, impact profile, and assessment timeframe.

### ◈ Purpose
Enterprise-level STIG compliance monitoring based on assessment results from **NIWC Atlantic's SCAP Compliance Checker (SCC)**.

### ▸ Use this dashboard to
- ◉ Evaluate overall compliance posture
- ⚠ Identify high-severity findings
- ▣ Compare findings across operating system families
- ↗ Monitor compliance trends over time

### ⌕ Filters
Use the dashboard controls to filter by:
- Time Range (Use the Kibana time picker in the top right corner of the dashboard)
- Impact Profile (MAC)
- Operating System
- STIG Benchmark

### ⚠ STIG Severity Categories
- 🔴 **CAT I — High Severity**
- 🟡 **CAT II — Medium Severity**
- 🔵 **CAT III — Low Severity**

> ⓘ Metrics reflect SCC data currently available in Elastic and may exclude systems that have not recently reported or been assessed.

> ⚠️ **Important:** Use a time range that isolates a **single SCC scan session**.
